subject: Post-demo: OptiScan benchmark plan & bespoke eval onboarding
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@optiscanhealth.com>, Daniel Kwon <daniel.kwon@optiscanhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T15:00:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: OptiScan benchmark plan & bespoke eval onboarding

Hi Priya / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Goal: validate model fit for OptiScan's triage assistant use case (summarization + triage label suggestion) on your clinical note subset.
- Recommended initial models: redwood-2-large (quantized) for throughput-sensitive flows; redwood-2-xlarge for highest F1 on longer notes. We'll also propose a distilled variant for low-latency endpoints.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Share a ~500–1,000 row sample of de-identified notes in CSV (we discussed columns: note_id, text, gold_label). If you want, send the small sample directly to this thread.
2) Confirm the scoring priorities (precision-first vs recall-first). You mentioned prioritizing false-negative reduction for triage; we'll capture that in the rubric.

On our side:
- Lauren will draft a lightweight scoring rubric and the eval template (Excel) for your approval.
- Marissa will prepare an internal runbook for the Redwood-hosted eval (dataset ingestion, model variants to test, hardware targets, and expected token cost).
- I'll schedule a 45-minute onboarding call next week to walk through the dataset format and scoring.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Today: sample dataset delivered by OptiScan
- +2 business days: Redwood returns eval template + rubric
- +5 business days: initial run (benchmarks & example outputs)

Attachment stubs: opti_eval_template.xlsx (template), redwood_model_benchmarks.pdf (summary of recent bench results).

If that looks good, Priya — can you drop the sample file and suggest 2 time slots for next week (EST)?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM serving
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@optiscanhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Kwon <daniel.kwon@optiscanhealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T19:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: OptiScan benchmark plan & bespoke eval onboarding

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned on the goals. Couple quick clarifications before we send the sample:

- Scoring priority: reduce false negatives (we'd rather flag more for human review than miss urgent items). So precision for high-confidence triage and recall for safety-critical labels.
- Sample: attaching a 600-row de-identified CSV; columns included: note_id, note_text, gold_triage (0/1), gold_label (multi-class), created_at. (attachment: opti_sample_dataset.csv)

We don't want PHI in the sample; this is de-id. If you detect any issues, flag them.

Available slots for the walkthrough: Tue 2/16 10:30–11:15 PST or Wed 2/17 09:00–09:45 PST. Please pick one.

Thanks —
Priya Shah
Head of Clinical Ops, OptiScan Health
priya.shah@optiscanhealth.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@optiscanhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-15T01:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: OptiScan benchmark plan & bespoke eval onboarding

Thanks for the sample, Priya — this is helpful. I've sketched a minimal scoring rubric and a proposed eval run plan below. I attached an editable eval template for you. (attachment: opti_eval_template.xlsx)

High-level scoring priorities (per our conversation):
- Primary metric: F1 on urgent triage (gold_triage). Because you emphasized false-negative reduction, we'll include recall-weighted F1 and a separate recall@0.5 threshold.
- Secondary metrics: macro F1 for multi-class label match; calibration (confidence vs accuracy) for the top predicted label.
- Quality regression guards: if any model variant drops F1 by >3 points relative to baseline redwood-2-large on the sample set, trigger a manual QA review and rollback for production routes.

Eval run plan (initial pass):
1) Ingest your CSV (we checked columns: good). We'll run basic validation checks (missing labels, length distribution, sampling bias).
2) Run model variants: redwood-2-large (quantized), redwood-2-xlarge (float16), redwood-2-distil (low-latency).
3) Token and latency targets: aim for median p95 latency <120ms for the large quantized variant on our dedicated pool; cost estimate will be included in the run report.
4) Output artifacts: per-row predictions with top-3 labels and confidences, aggregate metrics, confusion matrices, example failure cases (10 per label).

Operational notes:
- Data access: we'll host the sample transiently in a private S3 bucket linked to the eval. Data retention for samples is 30 days by default; we can change this per your compliance needs.
- Security: SOC2 controls apply on Redwood-managed evals; if you need a Private deployment for the eval, let us know and we'll route to the appropriate team.

Next steps: Ben — can you book the walkthrough for Tue 2/16 10:30 PST? We'll use that call to confirm scoring thresholds and any label mapping rules.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
From: Daniel Kwon <daniel.kwon@optiscanhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@optiscanhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-17T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: OptiScan benchmark plan & bespoke eval onboarding

Hi all — quick note to confirm the Wed slot (we picked Wed 2/17 09:00 PST) and that the rubric looks appropriate. A few small asks before the call:

- Can Redwood include an explicit example set of 'failure cases' you plan to surface (format: note_id, model_pred, gold_label, failure_reason)? That will help our clinical reviewers triage.
- Please attach the model bench PDF you mentioned (redwood_model_benchmarks.pdf) and an estimated token cost for the three variants on our 10k-row projected pilot.

We'll be on the call with our clinical lead and one of our engineers. Looking forward to the run-through.

Thanks,
Daniel
Engineering Manager, OptiScan Health
daniel.kwon@optiscanhealth.com
